exposure: trial of labor (elective or urgent CS)
Trial of labor (elective or urgent CS)
cohort: Women with a history of cesarean section (CS) admitted to Zhejiang Tongde Hospital from January 2017 to December 2019
finding: Multiple cesarean deliveries, elective cesarean section, cesarean interval of less than 5 years, and retroflexed position of the uterus were independent risk factors for CSD in women with a history of CS.
mod_finding: Elective cesarean section was found to be an independent risk factor for CSD.
